title: Policy Authoring and Certifiable Export Paths for Interactive Request Lifecycles
creator: Lina Park
description: Enable teams to author fine-grained data lifecycle policies for interactive LLM requests (prompts, responses, request logs, and derived metrics) with an integrated preview, selective sampling, and automated, attestable evidence/export pipelines. Deliver a UI flow and API primitives that let administrators: 1) define TTLs per-route/model/tenant and exceptions for legal holds, 2) create selective-sampling rules (percent/sample-size/condition) for prompt/response snapshots, 3) schedule encrypted exports with signed manifests for audits, and 4) simulate retention impact and privacy exposure before rollout. The feature must support RBAC gating, KMS-backed encryption for exported bundles, and an audit trail that surfaces in Console and exported evidence packages.
acceptance_criteria: Admin UI: create/update/delete retention policies scoped to tenant, route, and model with UI validation
Selective sampling: rules editor supports conditional filters (regex, metadata) and percent-based sampling with deterministic seed
Preview: policy simulator shows estimated token and object deletion counts and storage cost delta for a 30-day window
Export pipeline: scheduled exports produce encrypted ZIP bundles to S3/GCS with a signed manifest (SHA256) and KMS envelope key
Evidence packaging: exported bundle includes tamper-evident manifest, access log, and sample prompts/responses with redaction markers
APIs/CLI: CRUD operations for policies and a /simulate endpoint returning cost/size estimates
Audit trail: every policy change emits an immutable audit event surfaced in Console and retained per tenant retention rules
Security: design reviewed and an RBAC gate implemented; security_review_required flagged true
Telemetry: add metrics for deleted objects, exported bundles, export success/failure rates, and simulator accuracy
steps: Product: finalize policy model and schema (TTL granularity, exceptions, sampling rules, retention inheritance)
Design: wireframes for policy authoring and simulator screens; include export scheduling UX and legal hold flow
Engineering: implement backend policy CRUD, enforcement hooks in request router and archival worker
Engineering: build deterministic sampler as library used by runtime and export workers
Engineering: implement export pipeline with KMS envelope encryption, signed manifests, and storage connectors
Console: surface policy editor, preview simulator, export job monitor, and audit log viewer
QA: create test matrix for policy inheritance, simulator accuracy, export integrity and DRM of manifests
Security: perform threat model and run security review; implement RBAC checks and key rotation procedures
PM: pilot with two customers and collect policy templates and compliance requirements
Release: staged rollout (canary tenants -> opt-in -> GA) with migration plan for existing retention configs
